name: NorthstarSupportChatbot
description: An AI-powered chatbot that classifies and auto-replies to common inquiries at Northstar.

customer_message.description: The incoming message from the customer.

order_id.description: The order ID pertaining to the customer inquiry.

product_name.description: The name of the queried product.

category.description: The classified category of the customer's inquiry.

final_reply.description: The final composed reply to be sent to the customer.

methods.name: classify_question
methods.description: Classifies the customer's question into one of the predefined categories.

methods.name: route_by_category
methods.description: Routes the classified question to the appropriate handler.

methods.name: check_order_id_present
methods.description: Checks if an order ID is present and routes accordingly.

methods.name: lookup_order_status
methods.description: Looks up the order status based on the provided order ID.

methods.name: save_order_reply
methods.description: Saves the composed reply regarding the order status.

methods.name: request_order_id
methods.description: Requests the user to provide their order ID that is currently missing.

methods.name: save_order_id_missing_reply
methods.description: Saves the response asking for the missing order ID.

methods.name: lookup_return_policy
methods.description: Looks up the return policy details for the customer's query.

methods.name: save_return_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply about the return policy.

methods.name: check_stock_availability
methods.description: Checks if the requested product is in stock.

methods.name: save_stock_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply regarding stock availability.

methods.name: flag_for_human_review
methods.description: Flags inquiries that are out of scope for human review.

methods.name: save_escalation_reply
methods.description: Saves the reply indicating that the inquiry is escalated for human intervention.
